Figure 3:Amortized discovery of minimal reaction-condition sets on the Suzuki
coupling.(a)Two held-out substrate pairs with their ground-truth antichains.
Each row of chips names one minimal set of dimensions allowed to vary from the
baseline (cat catalyst system, solv solvent, Pd loading, T temperature).(b)Recall on each held-out substrate
within the window of 32 distinct condition sets, with the values of each policy sorted in decreasing order. The
shaded gap between the conditioned and the substrate-blind policy is the recall that the
substrate fingerprint adds.
